entries.test: idle sessions are swept and the current and fresh ones are kept
entries.reason: sweepIdleSessions compares the kernel-set mtime of the fresh session directory, written moments earlier on the real clock, with Date.now(); shifted 45 days ahead, that directory reads as idle past the 14-day idleSessionMs and is swept.

entries.test: stopWait waits a bounded number of times per session and expires an old counter
entries.reason: stopWait first runs sweepStaleWaits, which compares the kernel-set mtime of the wait counter, written moments earlier on the real clock, with Date.now(); shifted 45 days ahead, the counter reads as older than the 24-hour waitTtlMs and is swept, so every wait counts from 1.

entries.test: main never writes stdout in record mode and always answers in check, tree and stop-wait modes
entries.reason: its stop-wait leg runs sweepStaleWaits, which compares the kernel-set mtime of the wait counter, written moments earlier on the real clock, with Date.now(); shifted 45 days ahead, the counter is swept before each wait, so the fourth wait never reaches the limit.

entries.test: stale wait counters are swept and fresh ones are kept
entries.reason: sweepStaleWaits compares the kernel-set mtime of the fresh wait counter, written moments earlier on the real clock, with Date.now(); shifted 45 days ahead, the fresh counter reads as older than the 24-hour waitTtlMs and is swept together with the stale one.

entries.test: freshness sees a restored modification time and a deleted changed file
entries.reason: check takes a changed file's change time as max(mtime, ctime), and the kernel sets ctime on the real clock while the launch is recorded at the shifted Date.now(); shifted 45 days ahead, a restored mtime one day before the launch reads as older than the launch, so the review reads as fresh.
